geometry_edits.rationale: Upgrade the primary mass from a generic bar to a more legible continuous bent bar, matching the observed curved/stepped gesture.
Moderate the bend to keep the silhouette coherent across views without collapsing into a box.
Preserve the longitudinal bar logic that supports neighborhood-living program organization.
Transform the weak cave into a clearer public court/void so the ground edge can become legible and usable.
Keep the void large enough to read as public open space rather than decorative subtraction.
Open the court to the verified access edge to satisfy the active threshold requirement.

graph_edits.rationale: Retain the dominant bar but make it read as a clearer continuous primary mass rather than a generic extrusion.
Keep the long-axis dominance aligned to the neighborhood bar logic.
Strengthen the primary mass so the supporting void reads against a more decisive anchor.
Deepen the subtractive gesture so the frontage can read as a usable public undercut/threshold.
Widen the void to make the access edge and open-space figure legible in elevation and plan.
Align the cavity to the verified access side so the public threshold addresses the street condition.

rationale: The candidate reads as a compact bent bar with a stepped upper profile, but the mass is still largely generic and only partially coherent across views. The dominant gesture is visible, yet the open-space figure is weak: the blue access edge is not answered by a clearly public court, notch, or undercut, and the relation to the parcel is mostly containment rather than an obvious site-driven orientation. In plan and elevation it behaves like a slightly deformed box with stepped roof massing rather than a clear neighborhood building with an active ground threshold. It does resonate somewhat with the similar references through low-rise horizontality and terrace-like massing, but it does not yet carry enough void logic or section-based public sequence to satisfy the neighborhood_living brief. The form also risks reading as a shallow stack/cascade rather than a deliberately composed active-bar building. Therefore program_fit_hard_pass fails, mainly due to inadequate public threshold and section-program support.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: More overtly cultural/pavilion-like than residential-commercial; should not be copied as a pure object.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A compact civic mass with a clear central void and layered upper bridging can support neighborhood-living when the ground edge stays legible.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Scale is larger and more campus-like than this candidate; risk of over-fragmentation if imitated directly.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Terraced, campus-like aggregation around a central open space can organize mixed neighborhood program while preserving hierarchy.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Reference is more open and transparent; candidate currently lacks the same public threshold clarity.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Long horizontal massing with a carved central court and responsive roofline suits active ground-floor neighborhood use.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: This reference is much more sectional and landscape-integrated; candidate is too compact and boxy by comparison.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Terraced, ribbon-like sectioning and a clear public forecourt/court can give a neighborhood building usable open-space hierarchy.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Candidate is far less articulated and needs a cleaner void/threshold rather than more stacked fragments.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Interlocking bars with a central void and some upper-level bridging can create a legible mixed-use massing figure.

warnings: Parcel containment appears acceptable, but the mass does not strongly exploit the parcel edge conditions.
Access edge response is semantically weak: no legible entry seam, court, or undercut is aligned to the verified frontage.
The silhouette is coherent, but the stepped upper mass alone is not enough to resolve the program contract.
Do not increase fragmentation; the issue is missing void/public threshold rather than too many pieces.
